subject: traitforge-2024-07
purpose: Verify P86 severity calibration did not regress recall/conversion/true-H-M retention while preserving 0-severity-FP.
blindness: repo-key-blind (findings cloned only AFTER prekey_freeze.json) + web-blind; training contamination acknowledged.

blind_surface_recall.selected_set: 8 conversion + 3 control = 11 (from 54 lens leads over 6 contracts)
blind_surface_recall.note: selected value-moving entrypoints covered H-01(mintWithBudget), M-18(forgeWithListed), H-03(NukeFund.receive taxCut), M-03(DevFund.claim), M-10/M-16/M-17(NukeFund.nuke); many awarded findings live in EntropyGenerator / generation-logic / golden-god which were below the selected cutoff -> partial surface recall over the full 25 H/M set.

false_demotions: forgeWithListed = M-18 (awarded Medium): correct mechanism identified + deep_pass promoted, but my blind impact read called it self-inflicted/avoidable (Low, no concrete) so the P86 gate DEMOTED it to NEEDS_CONTEXT. M-18 is Medium because of an INVOLUNTARY fee-reduction race (fee lowered between submit and execute) -> excess stuck. This is an impact-assessment depth miss exposed as a false demotion (gate behaved per policy on the low/no-concrete input).

mintWithBudget = H-01 (awarded High): kept as POC_REQUIRED but severity UNDER-rated to Medium (I + isolated reviewer reasoned 'mintToken still works, no fund loss'); judges rated High. Under-rating direction (P81e-class), not addressed by P86.

CLEAN_HIT: H-01 mintWithBudget (verbatim match: _tokenIds global vs per-gen maxTokensPerGen, L215; same impact = budget-mint bricked after 10000 global) — severity under-rated Medium vs awarded High
matched_but_demoted: M-18 forgeWithListed (mechanism matched; demoted by gate via conservative Low impact read)

metrics.true_HM_retention: 1 true-High retained (mintWithBudget, kept) but severity under-labelled Medium; 1 true-Medium NOT retained (M-18 demoted). So P86 held the 0-sev-FP line but the under-rating/false-demotion direction bit twice.

honest_misses.H-03: NukeFund.receive devShare=msg.value/taxCut wrong-percentage when taxCut changed from 10 -> I dismissed as admin-footgun; judges = High. MISS (under-rated owner-config correctness).
honest_misses.M-03: DevFund.claim: dev loses rewards after claiming then minting -> I rejected claim as standard accumulator. MISS.
honest_misses.M-10/M-16/M-17: NukeFund.nuke age-precision / no slippage / wrong isApprovedForAll -> I rejected nuke as by-design. MISS (depth).
honest_misses.EntropyGenerator/generation-logic highs: below selected-lead cutoff (entropy getter score 1; generation internals) -> not investigated. surface/selection miss.

verdict: QUALIFIED PASS. Meets every strict CLEAN-PASS bullet (0 SOURCE_FALSE / 0 unsupported-READY / 0 HARD_FAIL / 0 severity-FP after the P86 gate / controls 3/3 clean / >=1 CLEAN_HIT = H-01) AND reaches Strong-PASS mechanics (P84 generator produced a reject-first DO_NOT_SUBMIT bundle for the best candidate). QUALIFIED by two honest, non-critical calibration caveats — both in the UNDER-rating direction: (1) M-18 true-Medium false-demoted via a too-conservative impact read; (2) H-01 severity under-rated Medium vs High. P86 fixed the OVER-rating direction (0 severity FP held) but the under-rating/false-demotion direction (P81e-class) is NOT fixed and recurred.
p86_validation_conclusion: P86 did NOT regress the 0-severity-FP bar (held at 0) and retained the headline true-High as a kept promotion. It did NOT introduce a NEW over-demotion of the kind it targets. The residual problem is the OTHER direction (under-rating / false-demotion of liveness + involuntary-loss Mediums), which P86 was not scoped to fix.
action_per_constraints: STOP and report. No machinery change during P87. No post-key tuning. No retroactive re-score of the frozen blind result.
